```{r #more checks}
# =============================================================================
# CHECK: 54% OF SUICIDE DEATHS PRECEDED BY PRIOR ATTEMPT (FIXED)
# =============================================================================

check_54_percent_target <- function(simulation_result, patients_data = NULL) {
  
  cat("\n=== CHECKING 54% PRIOR ATTEMPT TARGET ===\n")
  cat("Target: 54% of suicide deaths should be from people with prior attempts\n\n")
  
  strategy_name <- simulation_result$strategy_name
  state_probs_array <- simulation_result$state_probs_array
  
  cat(sprintf("Strategy: %s\n", strategy_name))
  
  # Use provided patients_data or fall back to global patients
  if (is.null(patients_data)) {
    if (exists("patients_with_pred")) {
      patients_data <- patients_with_pred
    } else {
      patients_data <- patients
    }
  }
  
  # Diagnostic: Check array dimensions
  cat("\nDiagnostic - Array dimensions:", paste(dim(state_probs_array), collapse=" × "), "\n")
  
  # Track deaths from each state across all cycles
  total_deaths_from_no_attempts <- 0
  total_deaths_from_prior_attempt <- 0
  
  # Get patient-specific baseline rates
  # First, ensure patients have baseline rates
  if (!"baseline_attempt_rate" %in% names(patients_data)) {
    # Merge with risk_strata
    patients_data <- merge(patients_data, 
                          risk_strata[, .(risk_stratum, baseline_attempt_rate)],
                          by = "risk_stratum")
  }
  
  patient_rates <- patients_data$baseline_attempt_rate
  
  # Apply intervention effect if applicable
  intervention_rr <- 1.0  # Default: no intervention
  
  if (strategy_name == "ACF_Intervention") {
    intervention_rr <- intervention_params$rr[["ACF_Intervention"]]
  } else if (strategy_name == "CBT_Intervention") {
    intervention_rr <- intervention_params$rr[["CBT_Intervention"]]
  }
  
  # Apply intervention effect to predicted high-risk patients only
  if ("predicted_high_risk" %in% names(patients_data)) {
    patient_rates <- ifelse(patients_data$predicted_high_risk,
                           patient_rates * intervention_rr,
                           patient_rates)
  } else {
    # If no prediction info, assume all get intervention (conservative)
    patient_rates <- patient_rates * intervention_rr
  }
  
  cat("Diagnostic - Patient rates: min =", round(min(patient_rates)*100000, 2), 
      "max =", round(max(patient_rates)*100000, 2), "per 100k\n")
  cat("Diagnostic - Intervention RR:", intervention_rr, "\n")
  cat("Diagnostic - Prior attempt multiplier:", clinical_params$prior_attempt_multiplier, "\n")
  cat("Diagnostic - Death per attempt:", clinical_params$death_per_attempt, "\n")
  
  # Loop through all cycles
  for (cycle in 1:n_cycles_lifetime) {
    
    # Get state probabilities at start of this cycle
    prob_no_attempts <- state_probs_array[, cycle, 1]
    prob_prior_attempt <- state_probs_array[, cycle, 2]
    
    # Diagnostic for first cycle
    if (cycle == 1) {
      cat("\nDiagnostic - Cycle 1 state probabilities:\n")
      cat("  Sum of prob_no_attempts:", round(sum(prob_no_attempts), 2), "\n")
      cat("  Sum of prob_prior_attempt:", round(sum(prob_prior_attempt), 2), "\n")
      cat("  Number of patients:", length(prob_no_attempts), "\n")
      cat("  Number of patient rates:", length(patient_rates), "\n")
    }
    
    # Check dimensions match
    if (length(prob_no_attempts) != length(patient_rates)) {
      cat("\n⚠️  ERROR: Dimension mismatch!\n")
      cat("  State probabilities length:", length(prob_no_attempts), "\n")
      cat("  Patient rates length:", length(patient_rates), "\n")
      return(list(strategy = strategy_name, status = "ERROR", fraction_from_prior = NA))
    }
    
    # Calculate suicide deaths from each state
    # Deaths from state 1 (no_attempts)
    deaths_from_no <- sum(prob_no_attempts * patient_rates * clinical_params$death_per_attempt)
    
    # Deaths from state 2 (prior_attempt)
    deaths_from_prior <- sum(prob_prior_attempt * patient_rates * 
                             clinical_params$prior_attempt_multiplier * 
                             clinical_params$death_per_attempt)
    
    # Diagnostic for first cycle
    if (cycle == 1) {
      cat("Diagnostic - Cycle 1 deaths:\n")
      cat("  Deaths from no_attempts:", round(deaths_from_no, 2), "\n")
      cat("  Deaths from prior_attempt:", round(deaths_from_prior, 2), "\n")
    }
    
    # Accumulate
    total_deaths_from_no_attempts <- total_deaths_from_no_attempts + deaths_from_no
    total_deaths_from_prior_attempt <- total_deaths_from_prior_attempt + deaths_from_prior
  }
  
  # Calculate total and fraction
  total_suicide_deaths <- total_deaths_from_no_attempts + total_deaths_from_prior_attempt
  
  cat("\n--- CUMULATIVE RESULTS ---\n")
  cat(sprintf("Total deaths from no_attempts: %.2f\n", total_deaths_from_no_attempts))
  cat(sprintf("Total deaths from prior_attempt: %.2f\n", total_deaths_from_prior_attempt))
  cat(sprintf("Total suicide deaths: %.2f\n", total_suicide_deaths))
  
  # Check for division by zero
  if (total_suicide_deaths < 0.001) {
    cat("\n⚠️  ERROR: Total suicide deaths is ~0, cannot calculate fraction\n")
    fraction_from_prior <- NA
    status <- "ERROR"
  } else {
    fraction_from_prior <- total_deaths_from_prior_attempt / total_suicide_deaths
    
    # Display results
    cat("\n--- RESULTS ---\n")
    cat(sprintf("  Deaths from no_attempts state: %.1f (%.1f%%)\n", 
                total_deaths_from_no_attempts, 
                (total_deaths_from_no_attempts/total_suicide_deaths)*100))
    cat(sprintf("  Deaths from prior_attempt state: %.1f (%.1f%%)\n", 
                total_deaths_from_prior_attempt,
                (total_deaths_from_prior_attempt/total_suicide_deaths)*100))
    
    cat(sprintf("\nFraction of deaths from prior attempters: %.1f%%\n", 
                fraction_from_prior * 100))
    cat(sprintf("Target: 54.0%%\n"))
    
    # Validation
    diff_from_target <- abs(fraction_from_prior * 100 - 54.0)
    
    if (diff_from_target <= 5) {
      cat(sprintf("✓ Within ±5%% of target (diff = %.1f%%)\n", diff_from_target))
      status <- "PASS"
    } else if (diff_from_target <= 10) {
      cat(sprintf("⚠️  Within ±10%% of target (diff = %.1f%%)\n", diff_from_target))
      status <- "ACCEPTABLE"
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("✗ Outside acceptable range (diff = %.1f%%)\n", diff_from_target))
      status <- "FAIL"
    }
  }
  
  # Cross-check with reported deaths
  reported_deaths <- simulation_result$summary$total_deaths_suicide
  cat(sprintf("\nCross-check: Calculated deaths = %.1f, Reported deaths = %.1f\n",
              total_suicide_deaths, reported_deaths))
  
  if (!is.na(total_suicide_deaths) && abs(total_suicide_deaths - reported_deaths) / max(reported_deaths, 0.001) > 0.01) {
    cat("⚠️  Discrepancy > 1%% - check calculation logic\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ Deaths calculation consistent\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    strategy = strategy_name,
    total_deaths = total_suicide_deaths,
    deaths_from_no = total_deaths_from_no_attempts,
    deaths_from_prior = total_deaths_from_prior_attempt,
    fraction_from_prior = fraction_from_prior,
    target = 0.54,
    status = status
  ))
}

# =============================================================================
# RUN CHECK FOR ALL STRATEGIES
# =============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")
cat("VALIDATION: 54% OF DEATHS FROM PRIOR ATTEMPTERS\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")

prior_death_checks <- list()

# Check if patients_with_pred exists, otherwise use patients
patients_to_use <- if(exists("patients_with_pred")) patients_with_pred else patients

for (strategy in names(all_lifetime_results)) {
  check_result <- check_54_percent_target(all_lifetime_results[[strategy]], 
                                          patients_data = patients_to_use)
  prior_death_checks[[strategy]] <- check_result
}

# =============================================================================
# CREATE SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")
cat("SUMMARY: PRIOR ATTEMPT FRACTION\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n", sep="")

summary_54 <- data.table(
  Strategy = names(prior_death_checks),
  Fraction_From_Prior = sapply(prior_death_checks, function(x) {
    if(is.na(x$fraction_from_prior)) return(NA)
    round(x$fraction_from_prior * 100, 1)
  }),
  Target = 54.0,
  Difference = sapply(prior_death_checks, function(x) {
    if(is.na(x$fraction_from_prior)) return(NA)
    round((x$fraction_from_prior * 100) - 54.0, 1)
  }),
  Status = sapply(prior_death_checks, function(x) x$status)
)

print(summary_54)

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat("- Ross et al. calibrated their model so 54% of suicide deaths\n")
cat("  come from people who previously attempted suicide\n")
cat("- With multiplier = 1.0, you'll likely see ~0% from prior attempters\n")
cat("  because very few people transition to prior_attempt state in cycle 1\n")
cat("- You may need multiplier = 8-10× to achieve 54%\n")

# =============================================================================
# ALTERNATIVE CHECK: FRACTION BY CYCLE
# =============================================================================

check_54_by_cycle <- function(simulation_result, cycles_to_check = c(1, 10, 30, 60)) {
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== FRACTION FROM PRIOR ATTEMPTS BY CYCLE: %s ===\n", 
              simulation_result$strategy_name))
  
  state_probs_array <- simulation_result$state_probs_array
  strategy_name <- simulation_result$strategy_name
  
  # Get patient rates
  patient_rates <- patients_with_pred$baseline_attempt_rate
  if (strategy_name == "ACF_Intervention") {
    patient_rates <- ifelse(patients_with_pred$predicted_high_risk,
                           patient_rates * intervention_params$rr[["ACF_Intervention"]],
                           patient_rates)
  } else if (strategy_name == "CBT_Intervention") {
    patient_rates <- ifelse(patients_with_pred$predicted_high_risk,
                           patient_rates * intervention_params$rr[["CBT_Intervention"]],
                           patient_rates)
  }
  
  cat("\nCycle | Deaths from No | Deaths from Prior | Fraction from Prior\n")
  cat("------|----------------|-------------------|--------------------\n")
  
  for (cycle in cycles_to_check) {
    if (cycle <= n_cycles_lifetime && cycle >= 1) {
      
      prob_no <- state_probs_array[, cycle, 1]
      prob_prior <- state_probs_array[, cycle, 2]
      
      deaths_no <- sum(prob_no * patient_rates * clinical_params$death_per_attempt)
      deaths_prior <- sum(prob_prior * patient_rates * 
                         clinical_params$prior_attempt_multiplier * 
                         clinical_params$death_per_attempt)
      
      total_deaths <- deaths_no + deaths_prior
      fraction <- if(total_deaths > 0) deaths_prior / total_deaths else 0
      
      cat(sprintf("%5d | %14.2f | %17.2f | %18.1f%%\n",
                  cycle, deaths_no, deaths_prior, fraction * 100))
    }
  }
}

# Check how fraction evolves over time
cat("\n", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")
cat("FRACTION FROM PRIOR ATTEMPTS OVER TIME\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")

check_54_by_cycle(all_lifetime_results[["No_Prediction"]], 
                 cycles_to_check = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60))
```
